title: Count Partitions With Max-Min Difference at Most K
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition nums into contiguous segments where the difference between the maximum and minimum elements in each segment is at most k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition nums into contiguous segments where the difference between the maximum and minimum elements in each segment is at most k. Return the total number of valid partitions modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Partition it into nonempty contiguous segments whose maximum minus minimum is at most k.
Return the number of valid full partitions modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: For each right endpoint, valid segment starts form one suffix interval because extending left can only widen the range.
Maintain that earliest start with monotonic max/min deques and sum prior DP values using prefix sums.
Shrink while max-min>k; set dp[right] to the prefix-sum range over valid starts; accumulate modulo M.
Every partition has one final segment, and the window invariant identifies exactly all starts that make that final segment valid.
editorial: Every partition has one final segment, and the window invariant identifies exactly all starts that make that final segment valid.
